purpose: Public performance and route-resilience contract for the core Moral Trade experience, including loading-state recovery, Web Vitals, API latency, error-rate measurement, cache posture, and honest non-claims.

observedFriction.label: Repeated loading interstitials
observedFriction.risk: Public routes can feel provisional if loading screens are generic or long-lived.
observedFriction.mitigation: Track route-level loading fallback duration, expose specific recovery paths, and keep route content server-renderable where practical.

observedFriction.label: Reasoning route resilience
observedFriction.risk: A public reasoning/review route failure undermines trust in the protocol layer.
observedFriction.mitigation: Use route error boundaries, retry controls, public-directory fallbacks, and route-manifest smoke checks.

observedFriction.label: Pilot liquidity perception
observedFriction.risk: Low live-offer counts can make the product feel empty if examples, directories, and next actions are slow to render.
observedFriction.mitigation: Measure time to first useful content for marketplace, worked-example, and onboarding routes.

metricTargets.label: Public route error rate
metricTargets.target: <=1% of public route views over a reporting period
metricTargets.dataBoundary: Route names and counts only; no raw query strings, private wish text, or contact details.

metricTargets.label: Core API p95 latency
metricTargets.target: <=800ms p95 for public Moral Trade contract and directory APIs
metricTargets.dataBoundary: Route key, status bucket, and duration bucket only.

metricTargets.label: Largest Contentful Paint p75
metricTargets.target: <=2500ms p75 for public Moral Trade routes
metricTargets.dataBoundary: Route bucket and metric value only; no raw user text.

metricTargets.label: Interaction to Next Paint p75
metricTargets.target: <=200ms p75 for public Moral Trade routes
metricTargets.dataBoundary: Route bucket and metric value only; no raw user text.

metricTargets.label: Cumulative Layout Shift p75
metricTargets.target: <=0.1 p75 for public Moral Trade routes
metricTargets.dataBoundary: Route bucket and metric value only; no raw user text.

metricTargets.label: Specific loading and recovery coverage
metricTargets.target: >=90% of public Moral Trade route families have specific loading or error recovery paths

metricTargets.label: Build route manifest coverage
metricTargets.target: Every public Moral Trade contract route appears in the production build manifest before release.
metricTargets.dataBoundary: Route keys and manifest presence only.

instrumentationControls.label: Web Vitals capture
instrumentationControls.rule: Capture LCP, INP, and CLS by public route bucket with privacy-redacted analytics metadata.

instrumentationControls.label: API server timing
instrumentationControls.rule: Record core API duration buckets and p95 summaries without request bodies or private fields.

instrumentationControls.label: Route error boundary
instrumentationControls.rule: Public route errors must expose retry and safe navigation paths instead of a dead end.

instrumentationControls.label: Loading-state inventory
instrumentationControls.rule: Generic loading states must be tracked and replaced with route-specific progress or server-rendered content when repeated.

instrumentationControls.label: Production route manifest smoke
instrumentationControls.rule: Build verification must confirm public Moral Trade contract and marketplace routes are present.

routeFamilies.recoveryExpectation: Public contract routes render from static profile data or return validator blockers.
Marketplace routes keep worked examples, validation guidance, and create-entry actions visible even with low live liquidity.
Private matching previews degrade to broad, privacy-thresholded states without leaking exact wishes.
Review and reasoning pages expose safe navigation and retry paths if a route fails; packet JSON returns validator blockers instead of a public route crash.

releaseGates.label: Instrument before optimizing
releaseGates.rule: Do not claim performance readiness from design intent alone; publish measurement coverage first.

releaseGates.label: Public route resilience
releaseGates.rule: Do not expand public acquisition until core public routes have retry/recovery affordances and build-manifest coverage.

releaseGates.label: Privacy-safe telemetry
releaseGates.rule: Do not store performance telemetry that includes raw private wishes, source notes, contact details, or unredacted query strings.

publicNonClaims: Moral Trade does not claim verified Core Web Vitals pass status until route-level samples are collected and published in aggregate.
Moral Trade does not claim all loading states are optimized; generic fallbacks are tracked as route-resilience debt.
Moral Trade does not claim production API latency targets are met without current server-timing or provider metrics.
Moral Trade does not claim performance telemetry can include raw private wishes, source notes, contact details, or unredacted query strings.
